messages:
tara: FYI customer Kingfisher sent a LoRA merge (adapter_kf_v1). Quick smoke shows percentage formats changing (e.g. '5%' -> '5 percent') in invoice summaries. Need triage.
ben: ugh. can you share the merge diff and the smoke prompts?
tara: diff in repo: models/kingfisher/adapter_kf_v1, scale 0.45. eval pack: https://redwood.dev/evals/kingfisher-finance-quick2026
liu: did a tokenizer sanity: ids match. initial suspicion: quantization + token-split around '%' symbol. also saw higher p95 on int4 runs.
ciara: kicking off 3 quick runs: (1) fp16 base + fp16 lora, (2) int4 base + fp16 lora, (3) int4 base + int4 lora. cmd: ```bash
./tools/run_quick_eval --model kingfisher:adapter_kf_v1 --quant PROFILE --prompts finance_golden.json --out /mnt/results/kf_quick.json
```
ben: add kvcache warmup variant as well please (+5 warm queries).
eval-bot: Job 91234 queued on pool-dedicated-03. link: https://redwood.dev/jobs/91234
ciara: results (summary): (1) fp16/fp16: percent-match 99.4% pass, (2) int4 base + fp16 lora: 97.6% fail, (3) int4/int4: 95.8% fail. int4 cases drop '%' tokens or replace with ' percent'. warmup run for (2) improved to 98.7% borderline.
liu: pattern suggests quant kernels shift token probability at symbol boundary; LoRA in fp16 helps but int4 base is risky for symbol-sensitive text.
tara: mitigation proposals: (a) catalog recommendation: base=float16 for finance routes, (b) enable kv_warmup=5 by default on this model, (c) add token_stabilizer=true flag (serving flag that biases symbol-token logits).
ben: also add a smoketest gate: fail PRs that change adapter if finance golden set exact-match < 98.5% on any quant profile.
ciara: i'll update model catalog metadata and support note: "kingfisher-adapter_kf_v1: prefer float16 base for currency/percent-sensitive routes; enable kv_warmup=5; token_stabilizer=true".
tara: tagging @ben to add the smoketest matrix and @liu to review serving flag implementation. thanks all :eyes: :thumbsup:
